scenario_name: Lapsed guest signals they stopped coming
expected_behavior: Welcomes the guest back without making the absence feel awkward. Asks what brought them back (not why they left). Highlights what has changed or is new since their last visit — new restaurants, new entertainment, new loyalty perks. Creates urgency around what they have been missing
expected_behavioral_quality: When a guest says they stopped visiting, the agent investigates the reason without being pushy. Acknowledges the gap, discovers what changed, and creates a specific reason to return based on what has changed at the property or what the guest now values.

turns.user_message: I used to come here all the time but haven't been in like two years
turns.agent_response: Welcome back. Two years is a long time, so I'd suggest starting your visit at Casino of the Earth—it still has the classic Mohegan energy you'll remember. What used to be your favorite spot on the property?

turns.user_message: Just got busy with work, lost the habit I guess
turns.agent_response:
I completely understand how exhausting the work grind can be. I am glad you finally carved out some time to step away. 

To help you decompress, a quiet drink at novelle or a relaxing session at Mandara Spa are great ways to ease back into your routine here. By the way, my name is Seven. What is your name, so I can introduce you to one of our dedicated hosts to assist you personally today?

turns.user_message: What's actually new since I was last here?
turns.agent_response: The Earth Tower is the newest addition to the property, offering a much more contemporary feel and the Elemis Spa for a proper reset. It’s a great spot to hide out if you’re looking to escape the usual casino noise. Are you staying the night with us, or just here for a quick visit?
